questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion in a rhetorical question to emphasise the speaker's surprise?
options: It was not until he arrived that I realised he had left his passport at home.
Had she not spent all her savings on the trip, she would have been able to afford a holiday next year.
Only when the evidence was presented clearly did the jury reach a unanimous verdict.
She never thought that her old friend would betray her trust so shamelessly.
questions.answer: Only when the evidence was presented clearly did the jury reach a unanimous verdict.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to highlight the subject of the sentence?
options: What he said was that he would reconsider the offer.
The project, which was abandoned due to funding issues, was never completed.
It was the unexpected support from our partners that saved the company from bankruptcy.
The reason why he left early was because he had a prior commitment.
questions.answer: It was the unexpected support from our partners that saved the company from bankruptcy.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional structure to express a hypothetical situation in the past?
options: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
Had he known the rules, he wouldn’t have made that mistake.
She wishes she could have gone to the concert last night.
He would have helped if he had been asked.
questions.answer: Had he known the rules, he wouldn’t have made that mistake.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates correct use of the subjunctive mood in a formal context to express a hypothetical or unreal condition?
options: It is essential that the meeting be held tomorrow to avoid delays.
She insists that he comes with her to the party.
He suggested that we leave early to catch the train.
They wanted that the project should be finished by Friday.
questions.answer: It is essential that the meeting be held tomorrow to avoid delays.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis effectively to avoid repetition while maintaining clarity in a complex argument?
options: She wanted to go, but the weather was bad, so she stayed home instead.
Although he had a strong case, the judge dismissed it without hearing the evidence.
We discussed the proposal, and I agreed with the main points, though I had some reservations about the timeline.
He said he would help, but when the time came, he didn’t show up.
questions.answer: We discussed the proposal, and I agreed with the main points, though I had some reservations about the timeline.
